title: Nasruddin Tale 189: The Donkey and the Mirror
summary: Nasruddin held a mirror before his donkey. The donkey sniffed the glass, gave a gentle snort, and went back to chewing hay....
full_text:
Nasruddin held a mirror before his donkey. The donkey sniffed the glass, gave a gentle snort, and went back to chewing hay.

"Behold the philosopher!" exclaimed Nasruddin. "He sees his long ears, his gray muzzle, and his shaggy coat, and is perfectly content to remain a donkey!"
moral: Look upon yourself without vanity or self-loathing.
